title: Panda eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='70' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#5a5080' transform='rotate(20 26 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='70' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#5a5080' transform='rotate(-20 74 70)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='90' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#5a5080'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='90' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#5a5080'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='8' fill='#5a5080'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='8' fill='#5a5080'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='38' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#5a5080' transform='rotate(-15 40 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='38' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#5a5080' transform='rotate(15 60 38)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='3' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='37' r='3' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#8a7fc0'/>
  <!-- snout/mouth line -->
  <path d='M46 52 Q50 55 54 52' stroke='#8a7fc0' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- bamboo snack -->
  <rect x='44' y='58' width='5' height='22' rx='2' fill='#4cd964'/>
  <rect x='51' y='58' width='5' height='22' rx='2' fill='#3ab84f'/>
  <!-- bamboo leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='60' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#6ef07a' transform='rotate(-30 42 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='60' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#6ef07a' transform='rotate(30 58 60)'/>
  <!-- paws holding bamboo -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='64' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#5a5080'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='64' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#5a5080'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
